title: ACIM Control Reference
source_docs: Motor Control Blockset HDL Support/Controls/Control Reference/ACIM_Control_Reference.md
text: Compute reference currents for field-oriented control of induction motor, 2 inputs, 2 outputs; {Number of pole pairs}, {Rotor leakage inductance (H)} sets the leakage inductance of rotor winding, {Magnetizing Inductance (H)} sets the magnetizing inductance of induction motor, {Rated Flux (Wb)} sets the rated flux, {Rated Speed (rpm)} sets the rated speed of motor, {Synchronous Speed (rpm)} sets the synchronous speed of motor, {Max current (A)} sets the maximum phase current limit for motor, {Input units} sets the unit of input values Per-Unit, {Base Current (A)} sets the base current for per-unit system and {Base torque (Nm)} sets the base torque for per-unit system. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Number of pole pairs
params.values: Number of pole pairs available in motor 2 (default) | scalar

params.name: Rotor leakage inductance (H)
params.values: Leakage inductance of rotor winding 6.81e-3 (default) | scalar

params.name: Magnetizing Inductance (H)
params.values: Magnetizing inductance of induction motor 30e-3 (default) | scalar

params.name: Max current (A)
params.values: Maximum phase current limit for motor (amperes) 3 (default) | scalar

params.name: Input units
params.values: Unit of input values Per-Unit (PU) (default) | SI Units

params.name: Base Current (A)
params.values: Base current for per-unit system 5.3611 (default) | scalar

params.name: Base torque (Nm)
params.values: Base torque for per-unit system 0.50072 (default) | scalar
